launch-fl-fort-lauderdale-hugh-taylor-bi.summary: The Grove is the park's Beach Gate concession area, combining a café and bar, shop, visitor seating, beach equipment service, and kayak or other recreation rentals near A1A.

launch-fl-fort-lauderdale-hugh-taylor-bi.needToKnow: Use the exact Grove pin rather than the main Sunrise Boulevard entrance when planning beach access or rentals. launch-fl-west-palm-beach-okeeheelee-par.summary: Okeeheelee Disc Golf Course is the park's 18-hole public course, laid out around the Pooch Pines activity area with open fairways, mature trees, paved park paths, lakes, and water-edge holes.
launch-fl-west-palm-beach-okeeheelee-par.cost: Palm Beach County invites the public to play and does not publish a separate daily course-admission fee. Bring your own discs; leagues, tournaments, instruction, or special events can require separate registration or charges.
launch-fl-west-palm-beach-okeeheelee-par.hours: The public disc-golf course is open daily from sunrise to sunset. It does not inherit the later hours used by permitted lighted fields or courts elsewhere in Okeeheelee Park.
launch-fl-west-palm-beach-okeeheelee-par.needToKnow: Navigate to the exact course pin and use the county's April 2026 park map to find Hole 1 near Pooch Pines. Bring discs, drinking water, sun and rain protection, and shoes suited to turf. Fairways run near lakes and shared park paths, so watch for water hazards, pedestrians, storms, and lightning.

launch-fl-west-palm-beach-okeeheelee-par.summary: Okeeheelee Golf Course is Palm Beach County's 27-hole public golf facility, arranged as three nine-hole courses with a driving range, practice areas, Golf Shop, and Okee Grill on a lake-and-palm landscape inside Okeeheelee Park.
launch-fl-west-palm-beach-okeeheelee-par.cost: For May 1-October 31, the currently published rates before sales tax are $46.95 before noon, $32.86 from noon-5:00 p.m., and $26.29 after 5:00 p.m. The latest time is not guaranteed 18 holes and has no rain checks. Live booking controls the final rate; rentals, food, instruction, events, and other add-ons cost separately.
launch-fl-west-palm-beach-okeeheelee-par.hours: The Golf Shop is open daily from 6:30 a.m.-5:30 p.m. The driving range usually opens at 6:30 a.m. and closes one hour before sunset; it closes at 5:00 p.m. Wednesday and reopens at 11:00 a.m. Thursday on mats only. Golf is offered year-round, seven days a week, weather permitting, but tee times and course conditions control play.
launch-fl-west-palm-beach-okeeheelee-par.needToKnow: Use the exact golf-course pin and dedicated golf entrance, not a general Okeeheelee activity lot. Reserve a tee time, arrive 15-20 minutes early, and expect pairing when needed. The facility is cashless, lightning can halt play, carts must return by dusk, personal coolers are prohibited, and Okee Grill hours are not currently published online; call the Golf Shop before depending on food service.

launch-fl-west-palm-beach-dreher-park.summary: Palm Beach Zoo and Conservation Society is Dreher Park's 23-acre ticketed zoo, with shaded tropical paths, hundreds of animals, family amenities, dining, and separately reserved animal experiences.
launch-fl-west-palm-beach-dreher-park.cost: Daytime admission uses variable pricing. Current online starting prices are $29.95 for adults age 13 and older, $27.95 for seniors age 60 and older, and $23.95 for children ages 3-12; children age 2 and younger enter free. Animal experiences, carousel rides, food, rentals, events, and other add-ons cost separately, and the live ticket page controls the final price.
launch-fl-west-palm-beach-dreher-park.hours: The zoo is open daily from 9:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m., with last entry at 4:15 p.m. It is closed on Thanksgiving and Christmas Day. The zoo normally remains open in rain, but severe weather can change operations and separately scheduled experiences or amenities keep their own hours.
launch-fl-west-palm-beach-dreher-park.needToKnow: Use the exact zoo pin and 1301 Summit Boulevard entrance rather than Dreher Park's south address. Parking is free and close to the entrance. Daytime tickets are nonrefundable and nontransferable, outside food and beverages are not permitted, most visits take two to four hours, and severe-weather updates appear on the zoo's live channels. Download the current digital zoo map before entering because printed maps are no longer provided.

Discounts, special programs, planetarium access, events, and future price changes can follow separate rules, so the live ticket page controls.
launch-fl-west-palm-beach-dreher-park.hours: The center is open Monday-Friday from 9:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. and Saturday-Sunday from 10:00 a.m.-6:00 p.m. It is closed on Thanksgiving and Christmas Day. Shows, the observatory, outdoor demonstrations, splash-pad use, construction areas, and special programs can operate on narrower or weather-dependent schedules.
launch-fl-west-palm-beach-dreher-park.needToKnow: Enter Dreher Park from Southern Boulevard, turn onto Dreher Trail North, and continue to the exact science-center pin. Parking throughout Dreher Park is free. The operator is expanding the campus, so use its current construction link before visiting and expect route, exhibit, or bag-storage changes. Average exhibit time is about two hours; weekday field trips commonly leave by 1:30 p.m., and children under 13 must remain with an adult age 18 or older.
